name: AbuseIPDB-feedback
description: G'-prime Workflow E: Scheduled submission of confirmed-malicious attacker reports back to AbuseIPDB. Queries attacker_intel DB for IPs with hit_count >= 100 and no recent report, submits each. Tracking: OPS-573.

triggers.name: Scheduled AbuseIPDB Feedback
triggers.label: Daily AbuseIPDB feedback run
triggers.description: Runs daily to submit confirmed-malicious IPs to AbuseIPDB for community benefit.

actions.name: Query attacker-intel DB for unreported IPs
actions.label: Fetch IPs with hit_count >= 100 not reported in last 7 days

parameters.name: query
parameters.value: SELECT ip, hit_count, last_seen FROM attacker_intel.profiles WHERE hit_count >= 100 AND (last_reported_at IS NULL OR last_reported_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days') LIMIT 100;

parameters.name: comment
parameters.value: Confirmed malicious: $exec.hit_count hits. Last seen: $exec.last_seen. Automated report from HAIST sentinel SOAR.

actions.name: Update last_reported_at in attacker-intel DB
actions.label: Stamp last_reported_at = NOW() for each reported IP

parameters.name: query
parameters.value: UPDATE attacker_intel.profiles SET last_reported_at = NOW() WHERE ip = '$exec.ip';

actions.name: Telegram daily summary
actions.label: Post daily AbuseIPDB feedback summary to operator

parameters.name: message
parameters.value: DAILY ABUSEIPDB FEEDBACK COMPLETE\nIPs reported: $query-unreported-ips.rows_count\nNext run: tomorrow 06:00 UTC
